title: Justice Minister Nominee Kim Seung-won Withdraws Amid Scrutiny
detail: Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won withdrew his nomination at a National Assembly press conference, 20 days after being tapped for the post, citing a desire not to become a burden on the Lee Jae-myung administration. The withdrawal followed opposition scrutiny over his role in a 2021 Covid-19 drug trial approval, alleged preferential treatment involving a disability cooperative, and a past drunk-driving conviction. Kim maintained his innocence while stepping aside.

media.caption: Kim Seung-won announces withdrawal of his justice minister nomination
